<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "EntityValue">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT pnode (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top-level comment explaining the first child -->
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entities &ent; and tags <child> ]]>
  </child>
  <sub:pnode>&ent;</sub:pnode>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-sys SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd-ext.dtd">
  %ext-sys;
  <!ENTITY shared "SharedContent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment block
       containing multiple lines of notes
       about namespaces and CDATA usage -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[ <item>Nested XML-like structure inside CDATA</item> ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&shared;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product)*>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseName">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?log-target level="debug" msg="Initializing inventory"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://schema.example.org/inventory" xmlns:m="http://schema.example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment: Product details follow -->
  <product m:verified="true">
    <![CDATA[ Data chunk containing markup: <product>&derived;</product> ]]>
  </product>
  <product>&derived;</product>
</inventory>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "ReferenceOne">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "&ref1; and ReferenceTwo">
  <!ENTITY % local-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ent 'MacroText'>">
  %local-macro;
]>
<?xml-rpc service="query"?>
<archive xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20023:tech:xsd:archive" xmlns:v="urn:version:2.0">
  <!-- Archive comment section describing records -->
  <record v:status="active">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA with special characters: & < > " ' ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&ref2; &macro-ent;</record>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "AlphaText">
  <!ENTITY beta "α BetaText">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc-file SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-custom-pi processing="true" mode="strict"?>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops">
  <!-- Important comment regarding epub namespace compatibility -->
  <section epub:type="chapter">
    <![CDATA[
      Some complex CDATA content containing β and other entities.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>β</section>
</document>
